title: SafeDiSTL: Decomposing Joint Constraints for Safe Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning
abstract: arXiv:2610.13737v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Cooperative multi-agent tasks often impose constraints on a shared objective or collective safety. A team level violation cost function can measure this constraint outcome, but does not distinguish which agents' actions most strongly influence that violation. We present SafeDiSTL, a constrained multi-agent reinforcement learning framework that allows for credit assignment even with joint constraint measurements. We use Signal Temporal Logic (STL) robustness to measure episode-level violation through running-maximum cost increments. Smooth full-episode robustness and differentiable dynamics provide action sensitivities, which allocate each cost increment across agents at the same decision time. These sensitivities account for delayed effects when weighting agents' shares of each cost increment. We study the framework in cooperative payload transport, connected navigation, and networked traffic control tasks. SafeDiSTL achieves 1.6-5.1x

translated_title: SafeDiSTL：面向安全多智能体强化学习的联合约束分解
translated_abstract: 协作型多智能体任务通常对共享目标或集体安全施加约束。团队层面的违规代价函数可以衡量这种约束结果，但无法区分哪些智能体的动作对该违规的影响最大。我们提出了SafeDiSTL，这是一个约束多智能体强化学习框架，即使在仅有联合约束度量的情况下也能实现信用分配。我们利用信号时序逻辑（STL）的鲁棒性，通过运行最大代价增量来衡量回合级的违规程度。平滑的全回合鲁棒性和可微动力学提供了动作敏感度，这些敏感度在同一决策时刻将每个代价增量分配到各个智能体上。在加权各智能体对每个代价增量的份额时，这些敏感度还考虑了延迟效应。我们在协作载荷运输、联网导航和网络化交通控制等任务中对该框架进行了研究。SafeDiSTL实现了1.6-5.1倍的（性能提升）。
tldr: SafeDiSTL利用信号时序逻辑鲁棒性与可微动力学提供的动作敏感度，将团队级联合约束代价分解并分配到各智能体，解决了联合约束下多智能体强化学习的信用分配难题。
en_tdlr: SafeDiSTL is a constrained multi-agent reinforcement learning framework that enables credit assignment under joint team-level constraints by decomposing violation costs across agents using differentiable action sensitivities derived from Signal Temporal Logic robustness.
